title: fix(app-shell): Home sends its deployment-notice, authorized-clients and API-key reads once per load
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9W6PBGd35eGZ3aW4WwdNVYk)_

Fixes #28085

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：首页冷加载时，部署提示、已授权 AI 助手、API 密钥这三个读取各只发一次（之前在打包后的控制台上分别是 2 次、3 次、3 次）；列表页本来就每个 URL 只读一次，不变，现在由一个新的请求计数测试钉住（带消融）。
- 为什么改：首页先画一帧完整页面、再切成"加载中"、再画一遍，里面的组件被挂载两次；另外"连接 AI 助手"卡片和管理员首次使用清单各自读同一份数据。每次打开首页白白多 5 次请求。
- 风险与回滚：产品代码只动 `@object-ui/app-shell` 两个文件（另加一个控制台测试文件）；首页现在在 `/me/apps` 回答之前显示"加载中"（这本来就是该标志声明的行为）。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useLauncherApps.tsx`（`firstReadDue`）、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/connect/connectedAccess.ts`（共享读取的生命周期）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/hooks/__tests__/useLauncherApps-26838.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/console/connect/ConnectAgentWidget.connected-30898.test.tsx`，预期 29 个用例全绿；列表页钉子：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/src/__tests__/App.listPageBootReadsOnce-28085.test.tsx`，预期 1 个用例绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Step 0 measured the card on a **production** console build (`pnpm console:build`, served by `objectstack dev --ui --fresh` from `examples/app-showcase`, seeded admin, headless Chromium 1440×900, a fresh page per load after sign-in, GETs under `/api/` counted from navigation to network idle plus 3 s), on `main` `bc6b7ffd`:

- **List page** (`showcase_task` ×4, `showcase_account` ×1): every URL is read once. `auth/get-session`, `meta/app`, `auth/me/permissions` and `me/apps` read 1 each, and `meta/object?package`, `sys_user_preference` and `me/localization` read 1 each too. The doubling the card names is still React.StrictMode's development replay, which this PR does not touch.
- **Home** (×1, then ×2 with response times): `GET /api/settings/deployment/notice` ×2, `GET /api/v1/auth/authorized-clients` ×3, and the `sys_api_key` list ×3. **None of them overlapped**: each repeat started after the previous one had answered. So sharing an in-flight request (the card's "Wanted") could not remove them. The causes, traced on the Console dev server with StrictMode turned off locally (a local edit, restored) and a React DevTools hook recording mounts:

1. **Home mounted its children twice.** `HomePage` waits on `useLauncherApps().pending` so it never draws a tile `/me/apps` then hides. `LauncherAppsProvider` set `pending` only from its effect, after the first commit, so the first frame had nothing pending and nothing narrowed. Home drew its page (mounting `DeploymentNotice` and `ConnectAssistantCard`, which read on mount), switched to its loading state when the effect published `pending`, then drew the page again when the answer came. Now the provider answers `pending` from the render that makes the first read due. Home draws the page once, after the answer. This also removes the first frame that drew a hidden app's tile, which the hook's own doc says never happens.
2. **Two readers of one answer.** Home draws the Connect an AI Assistant card and, for an administrator, the first-run checklist. Both call `useConnectedAccess`, and each owned its own effects, so each sent `authorized-clients` and the `sys_api_key` list. The checklist's reader enables later (after the settings read), so its requests came after the card's had answered. `useConnectedAccess` now reads through a store shared by every reader mounted at the same time, keyed by adapter and person. A reader that mounts while the entry lives joins its answer or its reads in flight. A change to `sys_api_key` or `sys_oauth_consent` re-reads that record once for all readers. The entry is dropped with its last reader, so a page mounted later reads afresh, as it did before. The store's subscribe/getSnapshot pair is keyed on the adapter and person outside React, not on a memoised callback (ui `AGENTS.md` #10).

Both are one-place fixes at the source of each repeat. Neither is a per-call-site guard.

<details><summary>Readings: production console, before and after</summary>

Before (`main` `bc6b7ffd`), Home, one load: 35 GETs; repeated URLs `deployment/notice` ×2, `authorized-clients` ×3, `sys_api_key` list ×3. Timeline of the repeats (ms from navigation, start → end):

```
deployment/notice     977 → 1075   1116 → 1305
authorized-clients    979 → 1098   1117 → 1335   1375 → 1430
sys_api_key list      979 → 1109   1119 → 1342   1376 → 1433
```

After (head of this PR, console rebuilt), Home ×3: 30 GETs each, no URL repeated; `deployment/notice` 1, `authorized-clients` 1, `sys_api_key` list 1, `me/apps` 1, `meta/app` 1, `me/permissions` 1, `get-session` 1.

List page, before ×5 and after ×3 (`showcase_task`, `showcase_account`): 26 GETs each, no URL repeated; the card's four reads 1 each (`meta/app` and `meta/app/showcase_app/bundle` are two different URLs).

Dev server, StrictMode off, mounts recorded through a React DevTools hook (before the fix): `DeploymentNotice` and `ConnectAssistantCard` mounted twice under the same `HomePage` element, each mount followed by its reads; after fix 1, once; after fix 2, `authorized-clients` and the `sys_api_key` list are sent once, with the checklist mounted.
</details>

## Tests

- `useLauncherApps-26838.test.tsx`, new top-level describe `the first /me/apps read is pending from the first render`: a page behind Home's gate mounts once, so a child that reads on mount reads once per load (a request count); `pending` is true in the very first render when a read is due; and false when none is due (no user, metadata loading, no apps).
- `ConnectAgentWidget.connected-30898.test.tsx`, new `§7 one pair of reads per page, however many readers`: two readers mounted together send each request once; a reader mounting after the answer joins it; a `sys_api_key` change re-reads that record once for both; a page mounted after every reader left reads afresh.
- `ui/apps/console/src/__tests__/App.listPageBootReadsOnce-28085.test.tsx` (new, the card's acceptance pin): a list page (`/apps/crm/crm_contact`) loads through the real route tree with the boot `main.tsx` runs, the real `preflightAuth`, then `App` with the real `AuthProvider`, `AuthGuard`, `ConnectedShell` (real `ObjectStackAdapter` and `MetadataProvider`), `RequireOrganization`, the `/me/permissions` scope and `LauncherAppsProvider`, over one stubbed global `fetch` that records every URL. `auth/get-session`, `meta/app`, `auth/me/permissions` and `me/apps` are counted at exactly one request each. Only the app's own content and the pages off the route are stubbed, as in the sibling `App.rootLandingReadsOnce-32633`. No `React.StrictMode`, since a built console does not replay effects.
- No existing test was edited.

<details><summary>Ablations (mutation through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored to HEAD, git diff HEAD empty)</summary>

- `useLauncherApps.tsx`: `const state = firstReadDue ? PENDING : heldState;` → `const state = heldState;` — 2 failed / 9 passed: `a page behind the gate mounts once…` ("expected vi.fn() to be called 1 times, but got 2 times") and `is pending in the very first render…` ("expected [ false ] to deeply equal [ true ]").
- `connectedAccess.ts`: `let entry = byUser.get(userId);` → `let entry: SharedReads | undefined = undefined;` (one entry per reader) — 3 failed / 15 passed: two readers together, the late reader, and the re-read on change.
- List-page pin, `ui/packages/auth/src/createAuthClient.ts` (`takePreflightSession`, the handoff that keeps the boot at one `get-session`): `  if (!slot || slot.taken) return null;` → `  if (!slot || slot.taken || true) return null;` — 1 failed / 0 passed: `expected { 'auth/get-session': 2, …(3) } to deeply equal { 'auth/get-session': 1, …(3) }`. Restored: blob == HEAD (`ab510ed0c019`), `git diff HEAD` empty.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The card's acceptance, "a list page load makes one request per URL for the four reads", held on a built console without a product change, as the 2026-10-31 reading (6538476483) found. The four doubled only behind the Vite dev server with StrictMode, and the order for this card says not to "fix" that. It is now pinned by `App.listPageBootReadsOnce-28085.test.tsx` with the ablation above (the card's claim amendment widened the surface to that one file).
- The QA reading on the card (6765285185) also named `sys_audit_log` and `sys_user` ×2 on a record page. Not measured here (record page outside this card's step 0).
- `me/localization`, which that reading saw ×2 on the list page, read once on the built console; its files are held for #33985 and are untouched.

## Verification

All on head `1feba497` (merge base `bc6b7ffd`), after the last commit. The product files are unchanged since `76497be1`; that round's app-shell checks (`pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` exit 0; `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/ --maxWorkers=2` under the verify lock, Test Files 2270 passed / 1 skipped, Tests 21007 passed / 9 skipped, exit 0) stand for them.

- `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run apps/console/src/__tests__/App.listPageBootReadsOnce-28085.test.tsx apps/console/src/__tests__/App.rootLandingReadsOnce-32633.test.tsx`, twice: 2 files, 3 tests passed each time (the new pin also passed alone once before the ablation).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console type-check` (covers the new test file) — exit 0.
- Consumers of the two hooks (round 1, unchanged files): `FirstRunChecklist.test.tsx` and the console `App.permissionsWave-29114`, `App.homePermissions-12700`, `App.rootLandingReadsOnce-32633`, `App.linkRefusalLanding-33063` suites — green.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran` on `1feba497` — 37 derived (the same 37 as round 1), 37 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN; the whole round under the verify lock, every family exit 0 on the first run.
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations` (ui) — 0 new citations.
- Dogfood battery: not run — no `!` in the title and no `(narrowing)` arm.
